label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
Thanks for asking, Deirdre, and for raising it here instead of just putting it in the table. I get the numbers and I'm not going to fight the move. Bronwyn needs the help, and I'm glad Grade 00 is getting it.

I'll be honest, though: this one has hit me harder than I expected. Noma and I have been in the Seahorses together for three years, since my first year teaching. She basically taught me this job: the sign-in sheets, the parent WhatsApp group, how to keep it together on a bad day. The kids know her well. Luthando and Mia already know her from aftercare, and the others ask for "Noma's song" at morning ring every single day. And in Term 2, when Zayd was having his meltdowns, she was the only one who could settle him. She sat with him under the jungle gym until he was ready to come back in.

So I'd really like a proper handover, and I have two specific requests:

1. Could Charlene come in for a day or two in the last week of term (1 to 4 Dec) to work alongside Noma and see the routine, the songs, and how we handle sign-in and parent comms?

2. Could Noma come and do morning ring with us the first week back, from 14 Jan? Even 15 minutes would help. The first weeks of Grade R are hard, with new kids crying at the gate, and a new assistant and new children at the same time is a lot. A familiar face at ring would help the kids settle, and it would help Charlene too.

Noma will still be on the property across the courtyard, so this isn't goodbye. I just want her to know how much this room owes her, and I want the handover to be done properly.

Thanks again for taking this to SMT.

Kayla
